modules.module_title: Taking charge of shift from Fitter-Weaving Preparatory

pcs.pc_description: come at least 10 - 15 minutes earlier to the work spot
bring the necessary operational tools to the department
patrol around the machines in preparatory department and ensure smooth functioning of all the machines in the department
meet the previous fitter & discuss with him/ her regarding the issues faced with respect to the quality, production, spare, safety, any other specific instruction
check whether any spare/raw material/ tool / yarn / any other material are thrown under the machines or in the other work areas
question the previous fitter for any deviation in the process and should bring the same to the knowledge of his/ her superior

modules.module_title: Handing over shift to Fitter-Weaving Preparatory

pcs.pc_description: hand over the shift to the incoming shift fitter in a proper manner
provide all relevant information regarding the count produced, idle machines, damaged machine parts if any

report to His/ Her shift Superior about the quality, production, safety issues or any other issue faced in His/ Her shift and should leave the department only after getting concurrence for the same from His/ Her superiors
report to his shift superiors as well as that of the incoming shift fitter in case his/ her counterpart doesn't report for the incoming shift
ensure the work spot is clean
